topic: Should the Spaces pane's Edit page stay reachable while memory spaces are off?
detail: Since #209 the sidebar hides the Spaces pane while spaces are off. SP-053's Edit page says why nothing is enforced and links to the switch, but that notice shows only when the state changes under an open page. Options: (a) keep hiding the pane (today); (b) show the pane with only the Edit page while off, so a policy can be prepared before switching spaces on. Recommendation: (a) until someone asks to prepare a policy while off; setup already works once spaces are on and enforces nothing before Apply.
